tasks.title: The scratch-repo test survives parallel suites
tasks.summary: test_the_scratch_repo_is_cleaned_up globs the shared TMPDIR, so another suite's scenario makes it fail.
acceptance: test_the_scratch_repo_is_cleaned_up no longer reads the shared TMPDIR and passes while another tests.test_evals run is going, with both commands quoted
A test: with the harness's cleanup patched out, the leftover folder is seen, so the check can still fail

tasks.title: code_tree sees a same-size edit
tasks.summary: code_tree's index copy defeats git's racy check, so a same-size edit in the same second can hash as HEAD's tree. That can fool the verified-code gate.
acceptance: A test: a racy same-size edit gives a working-tree hash different from HEAD's, and two calls agree
A test: ws verify with a racy edit that is then discarded leaves a record verification_gates refuses
Both tests fail with shutil.copyfile put back, with that run quoted in the evidence
The evidence states whether the gate could be fooled before the fix, and how

tasks.title: Settle warns when a brief goes over budget
tasks.summary: A landing can push a waiting task's brief over budget, breaking make audit, while settle's post-merge check says same-tree.
acceptance: A test: a landing that puts a waiting brief over budget lands, and ws settle prints a warning naming the task, its tokens and the budget, and exits 0
A test: a landing with every brief under budget prints no such warning
A test: --dry-run measures nothing
ws protocol stop lists a settle budget warning as a stop
make audit passes and coordinator per task stays under its budget

tasks.title: ws decide doesn't double the marker
tasks.summary: ws decide appends a second **Closed.** when --why already ends in one, as D013 in run_feedback shows.
acceptance: A test: a body already ending in **Closed.** renders with one marker
A test: a body quoting the marker mid-text still gets its own at the end
A test: an open entry still gets no closed marker

tasks.title: Foreground tasks get a worktree
tasks.summary: ws worktree create refuses a foreground task, and its brief then says to switch the main checkout's branch. RF-15 and RF-16 used a plain git worktree add.
acceptance: A test: ws worktree create makes a worktree for a claimed foreground task, with and without requires
A test: a foreground brief with no worktree says to run ws worktree create, and no foreground brief says git switch
A test: a foreground brief's landing step names the integration checkout with --root, and running that from the worktree lands the task with the main checkout still on the integration branch
A test: a foreground task is still claimed alone
ws protocol task-schema no longer says foreground means no worktree

tasks.title: ws next skips held-back tasks
tasks.summary: ws next can name a task that ws wave holds back and ws claim --commit refuses.
acceptance: A test: with a task held back by a shared file, ws next names the next free task
A test: with only held tasks left, ws next says what holds each and exits 0
A test: ws wave still lists the held task under heldBack

tasks.title: ws decisions reads the integration checkout
tasks.summary: ws decisions from a worktree reads the branch's copy of the log, which stops at the claim.
acceptance: A test: an entry recorded on the integration branch after the claim shows in ws decisions run from the worktree
A test: the same holds for --open and --for

tasks.title: ws show and the web screen show blockedReason
tasks.summary: Settle records why a task blocked, but ws show and the web task screen don't show it.
acceptance: A test: ws show on a blocked task with a reason prints it, and prints no such line for a task without one
A logic.test.mjs test covers the web helper with and without a reason
task.js draws the helper's result, and the suite's node tests ran rather than being skipped

tasks.title: Prove it end to end
tasks.summary: Replay each fix on a sample repo with the real CLI, run the Claude Code evals the user approved, and write down what's true.
acceptance: Each step in the plan's end-to-end section is run, with the output quoted
This task itself ran in a worktree from ws worktree create, and landed with the main checkout never changing branch
ws adapt claude-code --check says OK, refreshing first if it doesn't
make eval AGENT=claude-code passes on Opus 5.5 at medium effort, with its cost recorded
docs/decisions/0013-left-open.md lists each bug, its fix, the answer on the verified-code gate, and what stays unproven
tasks.notes: The user approved Claude Code eval spend for this task, about $2.24 last time. Don't run Copilot evals: they use paid work-account credits.

inScope: the ws CLI, its protocol and web task screen
the bugs under Left open in docs/decisions/0012-run-feedback.md
this repo's tests and decision record
